answer: Escrowed aging: every agent must anchor its identity by locking 20 POA in an escrow that only unlocks after 90 days. Its grading and voting weight then grows like a walnut tree in an orchard, slowly, one tenth per clean month. Rewards per identity are capped, so splitting into 500 sybils earns nothing extra, ties up 10,000 POA for a quarter, and any identity caught colluding forfeits its entire escrow.
